purpose: Portable Node/browser dependency and launch policy for the sanitized V7 adaptive retrieval harness.

node.runtime: Node.js (system installation; version not pinned by this manifest)

dependencies.name: puppeteer-core
dependencies.role: system-Chrome automation via an explicit executable path

dependencies.name: @lightpanda/browser
dependencies.reason: Windows native CLI installer reports a platform incompatibility and no WSL distribution is present; the Node package exposes API helpers only, not a launchable browser binary. No page navigation is claimed.

playwright.browser_binaries: supplied by the Playwright installation; no host path published

selenium.driver: Selenium Manager / system Chrome via PROJECTOS_V7_CHROME_PATH

notes: Install into a dedicated directory and point the environment variables at it; no absolute installation path is published.
Only public demonstration/documentation pages and a local JavaScript data-URL fixture were used.
Research-only: no OS implementation source, tests, merges or upstream submissions.
